records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Nora,

Thanks for trying Wrenfield. A quick tip: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them -- so the first few minutes are usually spent creating one project and adding a few tasks to it.

Let us know how it goes.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Bright Analytics* just joined on the starter plan!

decisions.rationale: Engaged admin replied warmly and onboarding call was held [email:e92f1b4c, calendar:b32956af], but 6 days in there is still no project, no invite, no milestone, and her reply defers a walkthrough to "some point" — low urgency. No tickets. 8 days left leaves some room, so modest unaided chance.

draft.subject: Re: Checking in on Bright Analytics' setup
draft.body:
Hi Nora,

Glad things are going well — and yes, let's do that walkthrough whenever you're ready. Happy to grab 20 minutes this week and set up your first project together; projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so that's usually the quickest way to see Wrenfield working the way you want. If it's easier, the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and I can answer questions as you go.

Just reply with a couple of times that suit you.

Best,
Nadia
